# The Lightsmith

> Mobile headlight restoration serving the Treasure Valley, Idaho — owner-operated, $150 flat rate, 5-year warranty, done in under an hour at your driveway.

The Lightsmith is a mobile headlight restoration business based in Caldwell, Idaho, owned and operated by Jack. We travel to your home, workplace, or driveway anywhere in the Treasure Valley and restore cloudy, yellowed, or oxidized headlights to near-new clarity using a professional multi-stage sanding and ceramic UV sealing process. No drop-off required.

## Key Facts

- **Price:** $150 per vehicle, all-inclusive. Second vehicle at the same appointment: $100.
- **Warranty:** 5-year satisfaction guarantee. If headlights fade before five years, we return and make it right at no charge.
- **Time:** Most restorations complete in under one hour.
- **Service model:** Fully mobile — we come to you.
- **Phone / Text:** 208-614-3414
- **Website:** https://lightsmith.llc/
- **Google rating:** 5.0 stars (13+ reviews)

## Service Area

Caldwell, Nampa, Meridian, Boise, Eagle, Star, Middleton, Kuna, Fruitland, Emmett, and surrounding Treasure Valley communities. Contact us for appointments outside these cities.

## Restoration Process

1. Multi-stage hand sanding removes oxidation, yellowing, and surface scratches from the lens
2. Machine polish brings the lens to optical clarity
3. Headlight Magics professional ceramic UV sealant bonds to the lens surface (professional-grade product, not available in retail stores)
4. Road-ready immediately after the appointment; water-safe after 1 hour; car-wash safe after 24 hours

## Why The Lightsmith Instead of a DIY Kit

Store kits (e.g., AutoZone restoration kits) use basic sandpaper and wax-based sealants. Results can look good initially but typically fade within a season. The Lightsmith uses the Headlight Magics professional ceramic UV coating, which bonds to the lens rather than sitting on top of it, and is backed by a 5-year warranty. You also skip the Saturday afternoon of labor.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does it cost?** $150 per vehicle. Second vehicle at the same appointment is $100. No hidden fees.

**Can I drive immediately after?** Yes. Avoid water for the first hour and skip the car wash for 24 hours to let the sealant fully cure.

**Are heavily oxidized or yellowed headlights restorable?** Almost always yes. Even deeply yellowed or scratched lenses can typically be brought back to near-new clarity. Text a photo to 208-614-3414 for an honest assessment before booking.

**How long does it take?** Under one hour for most vehicles.

**Does the restoration really last?** Yes. The ceramic UV sealant bonds to the lens and is backed by a 5-year satisfaction guarantee.

**Do you travel outside the listed cities?** Yes — contact us for appointments beyond the core service area.

**How should I care for the headlights afterward?** Use touch-free or gentle hand washes and avoid harsh abrasives. A full care guide is available at https://lightsmith.llc/care.html.
